result.summary: The FEAT-010 legend contract needs a centered-position invariant, but the bounded evidence does not identify the preview/source artifact rendering the target anchor, so applied state and the complete file impact cannot be established.
risks: The current Legend specification defines disclosure behavior but not horizontal position stability.
The referenced Test Cases verify badge or axis content, not toggle-position invariance.
The preview is UNAPPROVED and would require regeneration and review after the change.
checks: On route /, compare the horizontal center of [data-wh-anchor="wh-feat-legend-toggle"] before opening, while open, and after closing.
Verify mouse, Enter, and Space activation preserve centering, focus, and aria-expanded behavior.
Re-run TC-010-1, TC-010-2, and TC-010-4 content assertions to prevent evidence-label regressions.
Verify centering at supported responsive widths without viewport overflow.
blockers: No listed artifact maps wh-feat-legend-toggle to an actual preview/source file; the only directly specified implementation path, src/shared/ui/legend/Legend.tsx, is absent.
Without the rendering artifact or an anchor-to-file manifest, the review cannot determine whether the behavior is already applied or name the exact preview artifact affected.
